verdicts_or_reports.field: Text content after Special Key > Move line down
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Cursor line moves one line down: text becomes "  - child\n- item\n" (or equivalent swap), no extra blank line, trailing newline kept.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After Move line down the text became "- item\n\n  - child" — an empty line was inserted and the final newline was lost; the lines were not swapped.
steps: Open Documents > Indent.md (content '- item' / '  - child' with trailing newline)
Tap More options? No: tap the Special Key toolbar button (keyboard-style icon, bottom bar)
Tap 'Move line down (Ctrl + ↓)'
Observe editor text: shows '- item', a blank line, then '  - child'
Tap Undo once: original '- item\n  - child\n' is restored

verdicts_or_reports.expected: With regex enabled, search '(cat)@home' and replacement '$1@work' turns 'cat@home dog@home' into 'cat@work dog@home' ($1 expands to the captured group).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The document became '$1@work dog@home': the replacement text was inserted literally, the group reference $1 was not expanded.
steps: Open Regex2.md (content 'cat@home dog@home') in the notebook folder
Tap the Search icon in the editor toolbar
Tap the Toggle Find/Replace button (left of the search row) to show the replace row
Tap the 'Use Regular Expression' button (.* icon) so it turns red
Clear the search field and type (cat)@home
Clear the replace field and type $1@work
Tap the 'Replace (1)' button (single-step replace)
Observe the document text

verdicts_or_reports.expected: View mode shows the file text as written: "Costs $5 and $10".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: View mode renders "Costs 5 and 10": both dollar signs are dropped. The edit view still holds "Costs $5 and $10".
steps: Open Money.md (content 'Costs $5 and $10') from the file browser
Tap the View Mode (eye) button in the top bar
Observe the rendered text: 'Costs 5 and 10'
Tap Edit Mode (pencil) and then View Mode again: still 'Costs 5 and 10'; edit view still reads 'Costs $5 and $10'

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Cursor line '  - deep' moves above '- a': text becomes '  - deep\n- a\n' (lines swapped, no blank line, trailing newline kept).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Text became '- a', an empty line, then '  - deep' (no swap, extra blank line inserted, final newline lost).
steps: Open Documents > Indent2.md (text '- a' / '  - deep' with trailing newline)
Tap the second line ('  - deep') to put the cursor there; keyboard opens
Tap the Special Key toolbar button (keyboard icon, bottom bar; with keyboard open it is at the 4th icon)
Tap 'Move line up (Ctrl + ↑)'
Observe the editor text: '- a', blank line, '  - deep'

sign_off.notes: Sign-off is an override: I did NOT verify the areas clean. Two confirmed defects were filed and logged: (1) search/replace single-step 'Replace (1)' with regex on does not expand $1 backreferences (Replace all does); (2) View mode drops '$' characters (Costs $5 and $10 renders as Costs 5 and 10). Also filed once, not reproduced by developer: Move line up/down can insert a blank line and drop the trailing newline; my reruns were correct and the bad case looked like the cursor on the empty trailing line, so it is unverified. Checked and OK: sort by Name/Date/Size with Reverse and Folder first, sort persists across navigation; editor line move down/up each undo in one step; plain replace/undo; regex Replace all; view-mode lists, regex text, plain text; rotation keeps content. Not covered: MIME type and Folder local sort, .dotfiles toggle, Date/Size reverse on real differing timestamps (all files share one timestamp), Go to, Preserve Case, file create/rename, relaunch persistence of sort.
